parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_ShowContainer.swift`) and `TrackContainerProtocol` (in `_Plant_TrackContainer.swift`) within the `Playback` package share three identical members — `isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, and `pageToken:String?` — and differ only in the concrete type of their `item` field (`Show` vs `Track`). This is the canonical PAT pattern: a single generic protocol `ContainerProtocol` with `associatedtype Item` and the three shared members declared once would replace both protocols, with `ShowContainerProtocol` and `TrackContainerProtocol` either becoming typealiases or being removed entirely. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so the refactor is safe to pursue. Both protocols live in the same `Playback` package, so no cross-package boundary is crossed.
